verdict.rationale: Retell exposes a full-coverage SDK, CLI, and MCP server that let an AI agent script repeated single-item operations (create/update/list agents, phone numbers, knowledge bases) programmatically, enabling scripted bulk-like loops, but there is no documented native batch/bulk endpoint operating on many items in a single call. missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API endpoints or CLI commands operating on multiple items in one call, evidence of rate-limit-safe bulk workflows, and hands-on confirmation of bulk usage at scale
